name: BSP_Ai_EntityRecordConstruct
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Stores read by offset: 00A00038 record+0h from the first stack argument; 00A00040 and 00A0004A record+4h and +8h from the two floats of a pointer argument, the pose X and Z; 00A0005B record+0Ch from a byte argument; 00A0005E record+10h from the second stack argument; 00A0004D record+14h from a float argument; 00A00061 record+1Ch from a later one. 00A00058 COMISS against another float argument gates a second 00A371A0 interpolation whose destination was not traced. coverage: partial, and the gap is the ARGUMENT ORDER: 00A00031 PUSH ESI sits between the first three argument reads at 00A00020/00A00024/00A0002A and the rest at 00A00034/00A0003A/00A00046/00A00052, so the slots shift mid-body the way 00A0F810's do and need the same frame-walk treatment. Until it is settled the meanings of record+14h, +18h and +1Ch are not claimed. | Packet cc8_ai_target_weight_publish: the argument mapping is SETTLED with tools/frame_slot_census.py. 00A00020 needs no --pop and its seven reads fall on seven consecutive slots K=-4 through K=-28, which is arguments one to seven in order; 00A04560 needs four, one per RET 4 class test (--pop 00a04615=4 --pop 00a0462c=4 --pop 00a0465b=4 --pop 00a04672=4). Matching them against 00A04560's seven pushes backwards from 00A046A5: arg1 = ESI the class descriptor -> record+0h; arg2 = EDI which 00A04650 XOR'd to ZERO -> record+10h; arg3 = the float 00A0460F produced -> record+14h; arg4 = the SETNZ of 00A04568 CMP [entity+54h],2 -> record+1Ch; arg5 = the 00A045EA interpolation -> the 00A00058 COMISS test then record+18h, stored plain at 00A00091 or re-rolled through 00BD2F10 at 00A00083 when it is negative; arg6 = the immediate 1 -> record+0Ch as a byte; arg7 = the address of the pose pair -> record+4h and +8h. Two slot coincidences confirm it: 00A04597 (the pose X store) and 00A04688 (the LEA of arg7) both normalise to K=8, and 00A045EA and 00A04682 (the reload for arg5) both to K=20. Consequences: record+10h is ALWAYS ZERO, so the attacker_class key field 00A0F83C reads arrives at 00A08460 as zero from this path; record+14h is 009FDF30's class weight for entity+C4h times 00A04240(entity), so the class weight is natively the TARGET SCALE and not the inner weight; record+1Ch is the side being two or more, which is what 00A08460 receives as target_is_neutral.
